lines.zh: 我踩着不自然的步子走
lines.en: I walk with an unnatural gait.
This face still belongs to someone.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤还是原来那张脸。
lines.en: This skin still wears my old face.
One shoulder rides higher than the other.
I do not know where I am.
I hold this body together.
I move through the tree shadows.
My steps drag out long.

lines.zh: 我想不起来自己的名字
lines.en: I cannot recall my own name.
I walk toward the smell of the living.

lines.zh: 我的手背上有缝合的痕
lines.en: There are stitched marks on my hand.
I never look back.
I stand, swaying slightly.

lines.zh: 我的头偏到一个奇怪的角度
lines.en: My head tilts at a strange angle.
I hear my own breathing.

lines.zh: 皮肤上那道缝合线不是我缝的。
lines.en: That seam in my skin is not one I stitched.
These hands do not feel like mine.
I wait for an order.

lines.zh: 有什么在我胸口里面空着
lines.en: Something is hollow inside my chest.

lines.zh: 这张脸，是那个人留下的。
lines.en: This face is what that person left behind.
A dry sound comes from my throat.
I try to speak, but cannot.
I stand as if I forgot how.
I touch the thread on my neck.
I do not remember eating.
The wind passes through the holes in me.
Should I know you?
I look at you with someone's face.
Do not back away; I am not done looking.
There is too much white in my eyes.
I want to say your name.
I raise a hand, then lower it.
Do you remember me?

lines.zh: 我记得你的名字，却说不出口。
lines.en: I remember your name but cannot say it.
My jaw hangs a little loose.

lines.zh: 别怕,我不确定自己在做什么
lines.en: Do not fear; I am not sure what I am doing.
Your face reminds me of something.

lines.zh: 我停在离你两步的地方
lines.en: I stop two paces from you.
My shadow does not quite look like me.

lines.zh: 你的脸和我这张，有点像。
lines.en: Your face resembles this one I wear.

lines.zh: 我这张脸，是别人留下的。
lines.en: This face was left by someone else.
I no longer remember being cold.
I reach out, but do not touch.
Have we met before?

lines.zh: 我退了半步,身体晃了晃
lines.en: I step back; my body sways.
This body's wounds do not close.

lines.zh: 缝合线松了，我把它按回去。
lines.en: A stitch has come loose; I press it back in.
The pain is faint.
One stitch has come loose.
I press a hand to it.
I can still hold this body up.

lines.zh: 有什么从伤口里流出来
lines.en: Something runs from the wound.
I do not mind in the least.

lines.zh: 我的手指抽了一下，又停了。
lines.en: My fingers twitch once, then stop.
I am not sure I still get hungry.
That smell is very close.

lines.zh: 我朝你伸出的手走过去
lines.en: I move toward your outstretched hand.
Will I do something wrong again?
Is this for me?
I take it, slowly.
I can hardly taste it.
My fingers have no feeling.

lines.zh: 这具身体还记得怎么拿东西
lines.en: This body still remembers how to hold.

lines.zh: 谢谢,如果我还懂这个词
lines.en: Thank you, if I still know the word.
I strike you and do not recoil.

lines.zh: 我的身体比你想象的硬
lines.en: My body is harder than you would think.
I am shoved one step askew.
My arm knocks your shoulder.
I feel little pain.
You touched the thread on my neck.
It takes me a beat to steady.
You are pressed against my stitching.

lines.zh: 我往后退开一点，皮肤还不太合身。
lines.en: I step back a little; this skin does not fit yet.
Do not push me; I come apart easily.

lines.zh: 这具身体还记得一些事
lines.en: This body still remembers some things.
My hand is cold when I offer it.
Can you accept me like this?
I am not very good at breathing anymore.
Beside you, I am quieter.

lines.zh: 我想起一点温暖的什么
lines.en: I remember something warm.
Do not look at the thread on my neck.
Let us just sit like this.
I may forget by tomorrow.
But tonight I remember.
I bend to pick it up, stiffly.
This body's movements are imprecise.
It takes a while to grip it.
This body has no use for it.
I put it in my pocket.
It slid out of my hand.
My fingers have no strength.

lines.zh: 我用死人的手掂了掂它的重量。
lines.en: With a dead man's hand I weigh it.
Was this mine before?
I cannot recall how to use it.
I turn my head toward you.
Something is urging me.
My body moved first.
I do not want to, yet I am walking.
Your warmth is obvious.
I hear a voice counting.

lines.zh: 我听见那个声音在我头里数数。
lines.en: I hear that voice counting inside my head.
I am not myself.
Please step back a few paces.
I count three in my mind.
I try to go slower.
The urge has come.
I am truly sorry.
I cannot stop now.
You should have run long ago.
Any later and it will be too late.

lines.zh: 我踩过你的脚印，一步一步。
lines.en: I step into your footprints, one by one.

lines.zh: 我的步子很稳,不像活人
lines.en: My steps are steady, unlike a living man's.
You turn; I turn.

lines.zh: 我不知道我为什么要追
lines.en: I do not know why I chase.

lines.zh: 这身皮还是他的，人不是了。
lines.en: This skin is still his. The man is not.
You need not look back.

lines.zh: 我的步子没有声音，身上有药味。
lines.en: My steps make no sound; I smell of medicine.
I smell the living.
I am getting closer.

lines.zh: 这具身体不知道什么叫喘。
lines.en: This body does not know what panting is.
I try to slow, and cannot.

lines.zh: 我的步子很稳，不像活人。
lines.en: My steps are steady — not like a living man's.
I stop and watch you.
Do not run into a dead end.
I do not want to be like this.
Yet my legs keep walking.
Only the last few steps remain.
I am right against you.
My hand comes down.
This blow was not my intent.
My strength exceeds a living man's.
You are knocked far back.

lines.zh: 我按住你,像按住一件东西
lines.en: I hold you down like an object.
My arms carry no warmth.
I hear a bone.
I raise my hand and bring it down.
This body is good at this.
I let go and step back.

lines.zh: 这具身体记得怎么挥拳。
lines.en: This body remembers how to swing a fist.
I have done it again.

lines.zh: 我的手掐下去，力气不是我的。
lines.en: My hand closes with a strength that is not my own.
I am sorry, truly I am.
I should leave this place.
Do not follow behind me.
I sit up from the ground.
This body is not mine.

lines.zh: 缝合线从我下巴一直爬到耳后。
lines.en: A seam runs from my chin to behind my ear.
There is a stitched seam at my throat.
I try to breathe, and somehow can.
This skin belongs to someone else.
My memory comes in broken pieces.

lines.zh: 我站起来,骨头响了一下
lines.en: I stand; a joint pops.
It is strangely quiet around me.
I do not know which way to go.
There are living voices far off.
My feet moved on their own.
This cannot be called resurrection.
I am not yet sure what I am.

lines.zh: 有人在远处喊一个名字
lines.en: Someone is calling a name far off.
It might be mine.
Step by step, I head over there.
Do not let that voice stop.
My skin draws tight.

lines.zh: 我摔在地上,关节错了位
lines.en: I hit the ground; a joint goes out.

lines.zh: 水从我颈上的线里进去
lines.en: Water enters through the seam at my neck.

lines.zh: 我被掀翻,半天才爬起来
lines.en: I am thrown down and slow to rise.
An arrow lodges in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 那道光照得我脑子一片空
lines.en: That light empties my mind.

lines.zh: 这具身体不需要吃,但它在垮
lines.en: This body needs no food, yet it is failing.

lines.zh: 雷打得我整具身体都在颤
lines.en: Lightning sets my whole body shaking.

lines.zh: 这里什么都没有,连痛都没有
lines.en: Nothing here, not even pain.
